# Iron Mass — Project Analysis & Build Guide

**App:** Iron Mass (Package: `com.aistudio.ironmass.vzkfqr`)  
**Generated by:** Google AI Studio · Fitness Phantom  
**Architecture:** Android Jetpack Compose + Room + Kotlin Coroutines

---

## 1. What the App Does

Iron Mass is a **4-week periodized strength & hypertrophy tracker** with four main screens:

| Tab | Screen | Features |
|-----|--------|----------|
| 0 | **Gym Mode** | Week/Day navigator, exercise sets with weight+reps logging, rest timer (floating), progressive overload hints |
| 1 | **Macros** | Per-meal protein/carb/fat logging, water glass counter, customizable daily targets |
| 2 | **Roadmap** | Program tips, weekly overview, phase information |
| 3 | **History/Profile** | Full workout log history, user profile (weight, height, body measurements), program start date |

### Workout Program Structure
- **4 Weeks × 7 Days** (auto-recycles after 28-day cycle, up to 3 macro-cycles)
- Hybrid split alternating:
  - **High-Rep Days** (15×3 hypertrophy sets) 
  - **Heavy Days** (6–8×4 max-tension sets + pyramid sets)
- **Day 7** is always a full rest day
- Workout days: Chest/Triceps/Core → Back/Biceps → Legs/Shoulders → repeat with heavy variant

### Data Layer
```
Room Database (version 5)
  ├── workout_logs      — every set logged per exercise
  ├── macro_logs        — daily macro entries keyed by "YYYY-MM-DD"
  └── user_profile      — singleton row (id=1), body stats + reminder prefs
```

## 2. Bugs Fixed (from BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md)

| # | File | Problem | Fix Applied |
|---|------|---------|-------------|
| 1 | `app/build.gradle.kts:11` | `compileSdk { version = release(36) { minorApiLevel=1 } }` invalid DSL | Changed to `compileSdk = 36` |
| 2 | `gradle/libs.versions.toml` | Kotlin `2.2.10` + KSP `2.3.5` version mismatch → codegen failures | Aligned to Kotlin `2.1.21` + KSP `2.1.21-1.0.32` |
| 3 | `gradle/libs.versions.toml` | `composeBom = "2024.09.00"` too old for AGP 9.x toolchain | Updated to `composeBom = "2025.04.01"` |
| 4 | `app/build.gradle.kts` | Keystore signing config ran unconditionally, failing config phase when no keystore present | Guarded behind null-checks on env vars |
| 5 | `app/build.gradle.kts` | `kotlinOptions { jvmTarget }` missing → JVM target mismatch lint error | Added `kotlinOptions { jvmTarget = "11" }` |
| 6 | `app/build.gradle.kts` | `"ksp"(...)` string-based configuration deprecated | Changed to `ksp(...)` DSL form |

All 6 fixes were already applied in the uploaded `iron-mass-fixed.zip`. **The source is clean and buildable.**

## 4. Quick Build Paths

### Path A — GitHub Actions (Recommended, no local setup required)

1. Push this entire project to a GitHub repository
2. Go to **Actions** tab → select **"Build Iron Mass APK"** workflow
3. Click **"Run workflow"** → choose `release`
4. Download the APK from the **Artifacts** section once the run completes

**To enable signed builds**, add these GitHub Secrets  
(`Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions`):

| Secret Name | Value |
|------------|-------|
| `KEYSTORE_BASE64` | Contents of `keystore.b64.txt` (base64-encoded keystore) |
| `STORE_PASSWORD` | `ironmass2026` |
| `KEY_PASSWORD` | `ironmass2026` |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | Your key from https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey |

> The bundled keystore (`ironmass-release.keystore`) uses alias `ironmass-key`.  
> Both store and key passwords are `ironmass2026`.  
> The keystore is valid for **10,000 days** (~27 years).

### Path B — Local (Android Studio)

1. Install **Android Studio Meerkat 2024.3.x** or newer
2. Open Android Studio → **File → Open** → select project folder
3. Wait for Gradle sync
4. Create or edit `.env` and set `GEMINI_API_KEY=<your_key>`
5. **Build → Build Bundle(s)/APK(s) → Build APK(s)**  
   → APK at `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`

For signed release: **Build → Generate Signed Bundle/APK → APK**  
Use `ironmass-release.keystore`, alias `ironmass-key`, passwords `ironmass2026`.

### Path C — Command Line (Linux/macOS)

```bash
# 1. Ensure ANDROID_HOME is set
export ANDROID_HOME=~/Android/Sdk        # Linux
export ANDROID_HOME=~/Library/Android/sdk # macOS

# 2. Run the included build script
chmod +x build-locally.sh
./build-locally.sh release              # signed release (uses bundled keystore)
./build-locally.sh debug                # debug build
```

Or manually:
```bash
export KEYSTORE_PATH=$(pwd)/ironmass-release.keystore
export STORE_PASSWORD=ironmass2026
export KEY_PASSWORD=ironmass2026
echo "GEMINI_API_KEY=<your_key>" > .env
echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME" > local.properties
./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
# Output: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
```

## 5. Keystore Details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| File | `ironmass-release.keystore` |
| Alias | `ironmass-key` |
| Store password | `ironmass2026` |
| Key password | `ironmass2026` |
| Algorithm | RSA 2048-bit |
| Validity | 10,000 days |
| DN | CN=Iron Mass, OU=IronMass App, O=IronMass, L=Hailakandi, ST=Assam, C=IN |

> ⚠️ **Keep the keystore file safe.** You must use the same keystore for all future  
> updates to this app on Play Store. Losing it means you cannot update the published app.

## 7. Install on Device

```bash
# Via ADB (device connected via USB with USB debugging enabled)
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

# Or simply transfer the APK to the phone and open it
# (Enable: Settings → Security → Install unknown apps)
```

App targets **Android 7.0+** — compatible with virtually any Android device in active use today.
